headline: Russian October Crude Exports Fall 36.6% as Shipments to India Decline
summary: Russia's crude oil exports dropped 36.6% month-on-month in October to 2.794 million barrels per day, largely due to a sharp drop in deliveries to Indian refiners.
why: India has been a major buyer of discounted Russian sea-borne crude since Western trade embargos took effect.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Total monthly crude export volumes dropped significantly due to lower Indian purchases.
